yait_aichain.tools.chunk._chunk.Chunk.name: vector_chunk
yait_aichain.tools.chunk._chunk.Chunk.description: Split text into overlapping chunks for embedding and vector-store ingestion.  Handles plain text and Markdown, preserving headings, code blocks, and tables intact where possible.

input.description: The text to chunk.

yait_aichain.tools.embed._cohere.Embeddi.name: embedCohere
yait_aichain.tools.embed._cohere.Embeddi.description: Embed texts as vectors with Cohere's doc-model. Returns a summary — the vectors go to the code that called it, not into the conversation.

input.description: The texts to embed — or one text.

input_type.description: What the texts are, for providers that embed the two differently.

yait_aichain.tools.embed._google.Embeddi.name: embedGoogle
yait_aichain.tools.embed._google.Embeddi.description: Embed texts as vectors with Google's doc-model. Returns a summary — the vectors go to the code that called it, not into the conversation.

input.description: The texts to embed — or one text.

input_type.description: What the texts are, for providers that embed the two differently.

yait_aichain.tools.embed._openai.Embeddi.name: embedOpenAI
yait_aichain.tools.embed._openai.Embeddi.description: Embed texts as vectors with OpenAI's doc-model. Returns a summary — the vectors go to the code that called it, not into the conversation.

input.description: The texts to embed — or one text.

input_type.description: What the texts are, for providers that embed the two differently.

yait_aichain.tools.embed._qwen.Embedding.name: embedQwen
yait_aichain.tools.embed._qwen.Embedding.description: Embed texts as vectors with Qwen's doc-model. Returns a summary — the vectors go to the code that called it, not into the conversation.

input.description: The texts to embed — or one text.

input_type.description: What the texts are, for providers that embed the two differently.

yait_aichain.tools.embed._voyage.Embeddi.name: embedVoyage
yait_aichain.tools.embed._voyage.Embeddi.description: Embed texts as vectors with Voyage's doc-model. Returns a summary — the vectors go to the code that called it, not into the conversation.

input.description: The texts to embed — or one text.

input_type.description: What the texts are, for providers that embed the two differently.

yait_aichain.tools.fetch.exa.fetchExa.name: fetchExa
yait_aichain.tools.fetch.exa.fetchExa.description: Fetch a web page with Exa and return its text, with title, date and author.

url.description: The pages' URLs, http or https — one or several.

max_chars.description: Most characters of text per page (default 20 000).

max_age_hours.description: Use a cached copy younger than this (0 fetches fresh, -1 cache only; at most 720).

yait_aichain.tools.fetch.firecrawl.fetch.name: fetchFirecrawl
yait_aichain.tools.fetch.firecrawl.fetch.description: Fetch a web page with Firecrawl and return its main content as Markdown, with title, date and author where the page declares them.

url.description: The pages' URLs, http or https — one or several.

max_chars.description: Most characters of text per page (default 20 000).

only_main_content.description: Drop navigation, headers and footers (default true).

yait_aichain.tools.fetch.local.fetchLoca.name: fetchLocal
yait_aichain.tools.fetch.local.fetchLoca.description: Fetch a web page from this machine and return its text as Markdown, with title, date and author where the page declares them.

url.description: The pages' URLs, http or https — one or several.

max_chars.description: Most characters of text per page (default 20 000).

yait_aichain.tools.fetch.parallel.fetchP.name: fetchParallel
yait_aichain.tools.fetch.parallel.fetchP.description: Fetch a web page with Parallel and return its full content as Markdown, with title and date.

url.description: The pages' URLs, http or https — one or several.

max_chars.description: Most characters of text per page (default 20 000).

max_age_seconds.description: Fetch a page live when the cached copy is older than this (600 or more). Slower.

yait_aichain.tools.fetch.tavily.fetchTav.name: fetchTavily
yait_aichain.tools.fetch.tavily.fetchTav.description: Fetch a web page with Tavily and return its text as Markdown.

url.description: The pages' URLs, http or https — one or several.

max_chars.description: Most characters of text per page (default 20 000).

extract_depth.description: 'basic' (default); 'advanced' reaches tables and embedded content at twice the price.

yait_aichain.tools.general._wait.Wait.name: wait
yait_aichain.tools.general._wait.Wait.description: Pause the run until an external signal arrives.

yait_aichain.tools.image._tool.Image.name: imageOpenai
yait_aichain.tools.image._tool.Image.description: Make an image with openai's gpt-image-1.5 — from a prompt, or by editing the images given. Returns where the image was saved, or that it went back to the code.

input.description: What to draw, or what to change in the images given.

images.description: Images to edit or take as reference — file paths or URLs. None to generate.

size.description: Pixels, e.g. '1024x1024'; converted to the nearest shape where a provider takes a ratio.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. '16:9'; converted to a size where a provider takes pixels.

seed.description: For a repeatable image where the provider honours it.

fidelity.description: How closely an edit keeps its input: 'low' or 'high'.

yait_aichain.tools.rerank._cohere.Rerank.name: rerankCohere
yait_aichain.tools.rerank._cohere.Rerank.description: Put documents in order of how well they answer a query, with Cohere's doc-model; returns them best first, each with its score.

input.description: The documents to put in order — texts, or records with a 'text' field.

query.description: The question the documents should answer.

top_n.description: How many to return, best first (default: all).

yait_aichain.tools.rerank._qwen.RerankQw.name: rerankQwen
yait_aichain.tools.rerank._qwen.RerankQw.description: Put documents in order of how well they answer a query, with Qwen's doc-model; returns them best first, each with its score.

input.description: The documents to put in order — texts, or records with a 'text' field.

query.description: The question the documents should answer.

top_n.description: How many to return, best first (default: all).

yait_aichain.tools.rerank._voyage.Rerank.name: rerankVoyage
yait_aichain.tools.rerank._voyage.Rerank.description: Put documents in order of how well they answer a query, with Voyage's doc-model; returns them best first, each with its score.

input.description: The documents to put in order — texts, or records with a 'text' field.

query.description: The question the documents should answer.

top_n.description: How many to return, best first (default: all).

yait_aichain.tools.search.brave.searchBr.name: searchBrave
yait_aichain.tools.search.brave.searchBr.description: Search the web with Brave. Returns titles, URLs, dates and a description of each page.

input.description: The search query, in natural language.

recency.description: Only pages published within this window.

start_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

domains.description: Only these sites — a domain, or a domain with a path prefix.

kind.description: Pages (default) or images: each result then carries the picture's own URL, its size and the page it is on. Brave searches images.

extra_snippets.description: Up to five more passages from each page. Default false.

result_filter.description: Comma-separated result types: discussions, faq, infobox, news, query, summarizer, videos, web, locations.

freshness.description: Brave's own time filter — 'pd', 'pw', 'pm', 'py' or 'YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD'; wins over recency and the dates.

yait_aichain.tools.search.exa.searchExa.name: searchExa
yait_aichain.tools.search.exa.searchExa.description: Search the web with Exa, a search engine built for agents. Returns titles, URLs, dates and the passages of each page most relevant to the query.

input.description: The search query, in natural language.

recency.description: Only pages published within this window.

start_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. 'en'. Not applied here: Exa has no language filter.

domains.description: Only these sites — a domain, or a domain with a path prefix.

kind.description: Pages; this provider has no image search.

exclude_domains.description: Leave out results from these domains.

category.description: Focus on one kind of page.

search_type.description: 'auto' (default) balances quality and speed; 'instant'/'fast' trade quality for latency; the 'deep' modes search iteratively and cost more.

highlight_chars.description: Most characters of highlights per result (default 1000); 0 turns them off.

text_chars.description: Also return each page's text, cut to this many characters. Off by default — highlights usually carry the answer.

yait_aichain.tools.search.firecrawl.sear.name: searchFirecrawl
yait_aichain.tools.search.firecrawl.sear.description: Search the web with Firecrawl. Returns titles, URLs and a description of each page; can return each page's content as Markdown.

input.description: The search query, in natural language.

recency.description: Only pages published within this window.

start_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. 'en'. Not applied here: Firecrawl has no language filter.

domains.description: Only these sites — a domain, or a domain with a path prefix.

kind.description: Pages; this provider has no image search.

exclude_domains.description: Leave out results from these host names. Not with domains.

categories.description: Restrict to research sites, PDFs, the developer index or the government index ('gov' combines with nothing else).

location.description: A place to search from, e.g. 'Berlin,Germany'.

tbs.description: Firecrawl's raw time filter, e.g. 'qdr:w' or 'sbd:1,qdr:m'; wins over recency and the dates.

text_chars.description: Also return each page's content as Markdown, cut to this many characters. Scraping costs extra credits.

yait_aichain.tools.search.parallel.searc.name: searchParallel
yait_aichain.tools.search.parallel.searc.description: Search the web with Parallel, a search engine built for agents. Returns titles, URLs, dates and the excerpts of each page that serve the goal of the search.

input.description: The search query, in natural language.

recency.description: Only pages published within this window.

start_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Not applied here: Parallel filters from a start date only.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. 'en'. Not applied here: Parallel has no language filter.

domains.description: Only these sites — a domain, or a domain with a path prefix.

kind.description: Pages; this provider has no image search.

objective.description: The goal of the search in natural language; default: the query.

search_queries.description: Short keyword queries, three to six words, to run beside the query.

mode.description: 'advanced' (default) is the most thorough; 'turbo' the fastest.

exclude_domains.description: Leave out these domains or domain/path prefixes. Not with domains.

max_chars_total.description: Upper bound on characters of excerpts across all results.

max_age_seconds.description: Fetch a page live when the cached copy is older than this (600 or more). Slower.

yait_aichain.tools.search.perplexity.sea.name: searchPerplexity
yait_aichain.tools.search.perplexity.sea.description: Search the web with Perplexity. Returns titles, URLs, dates and a substantive passage from each page.

input.description: The search query, in natural language.

recency.description: Only pages published within this window.

start_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

domains.description: Only these sites — a domain, or a domain with a path prefix.

kind.description: Pages; this provider has no image search.

after_date.description: Perplexity's own MM/DD/YYYY lower bound; wins over start_date.

before_date.description: Perplexity's own MM/DD/YYYY upper bound; wins over end_date.

yait_aichain.tools.search.tavily.searchT.name: searchTavily
yait_aichain.tools.search.tavily.searchT.description: Search the web with Tavily. Returns titles, URLs, dates and the passages of each page chosen for the query.

input.description: The search query, in natural language.

recency.description: Only pages published within this window.

start_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

domains.description: Only these sites — a domain, or a domain with a path prefix.

kind.description: Pages; this provider has no image search.

search_depth.description: 'basic' (default); 'advanced' is more relevant and costs two credits.

exclude_domains.description: Leave out results from these domains.

exact_match.description: Only pages containing the quoted phrases of the query exactly.

filter_by_published_date.description: Drop pages outside the date window — and pages with no date.

filter_by_language.description: Make language a filter rather than a ranking boost.

text_chars.description: Also return each page as Markdown, cut to this many characters.

yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.Speech.name: speech
yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.Speech.description: Synthesise speech from text using a TTS model.  Returns the absolute path to the saved audio file.

input.description: Text to synthesise into speech.

language.description: BCP-47 language code, e.g. 'en-US'.  Google only — it is required there and the other endpoints have no such field, so they do not declare this option at all.

yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.ttsGoogle.name: ttsGoogle
yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.ttsGoogle.description: Synthesise speech from text using a TTS model.  Returns the absolute path to the saved audio file.

input.description: Text to synthesise into speech.

language.description: BCP-47 language code, e.g. 'en-US'.  Google only — it is required there and the other endpoints have no such field, so they do not declare this option at all.

yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.ttsOpenAI.name: ttsOpenAI
yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.ttsOpenAI.description: Synthesise speech from text using a TTS model.  Returns the absolute path to the saved audio file.

input.description: Text to synthesise into speech.

yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.ttsQwen.name: ttsQwen
yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.ttsQwen.description: Synthesise speech from text using a TTS model.  Returns the absolute path to the saved audio file.

input.description: Text to synthesise into speech.

yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.ttsXAI.name: ttsXAI
yait_aichain.tools.speech._tts.ttsXAI.description: Synthesise speech from text using a TTS model.  Returns the absolute path to the saved audio file.

input.description: Text to synthesise into speech.

yait_aichain.tools.transcribe._stt.Trans.name: transcription
yait_aichain.tools.transcribe._stt.Trans.description: Transcribe an audio file to text using an STT model.  Input is a file path; output is the transcript string.

input.description: Path to the audio file to transcribe.

language.description: Language hint (ISO-639-1 or BCP-47), e.g. 'en', 'en-US'.  Improves accuracy.  Auto-detected when omitted.

timestamps.description: Include word-level timestamps.  When True the output is a JSON string.  Default: false.

prompt.description: Context hint — domain vocabulary or spelling guidance.  Supported by OpenAI and xAI.

format.description: Output format.  ``text`` (default) — plain transcript.  ``json`` — includes timestamps and segment metadata.

yait_aichain.tools.transcribe._stt.sttGo.name: sttGoogle
yait_aichain.tools.transcribe._stt.sttGo.description: Transcribe an audio file to text using an STT model.  Input is a file path; output is the transcript string.

input.description: Path to the audio file to transcribe.

language.description: Language hint (ISO-639-1 or BCP-47), e.g. 'en', 'en-US'.  Improves accuracy.  Auto-detected when omitted.

timestamps.description: Include word-level timestamps.  When True the output is a JSON string.  Default: false.

format.description: Output format.  ``text`` (default) — plain transcript.  ``json`` — includes timestamps and segment metadata.

yait_aichain.tools.transcribe._stt.sttOp.name: sttOpenAI
yait_aichain.tools.transcribe._stt.sttOp.description: Transcribe an audio file to text using an STT model.  Input is a file path; output is the transcript string.

input.description: Path to the audio file to transcribe.

language.description: Language hint (ISO-639-1 or BCP-47), e.g. 'en', 'en-US'.  Improves accuracy.  Auto-detected when omitted.

timestamps.description: Include word-level timestamps.  When True the output is a JSON string.  Default: false.

prompt.description: Context hint — domain vocabulary or spelling guidance.  Supported by OpenAI and xAI.

format.description: Output format.  ``text`` (default) — plain transcript.  ``json`` — includes timestamps and segment metadata.

yait_aichain.tools.video._tool.Video.name: videoGoogle
yait_aichain.tools.video._tool.Video.description: Make a video with google's veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview — from a prompt, or from an image as its first frame. Takes minutes. Returns where the video was saved, or that it went back to the code.

input.description: What the video shows.

images.description: One image as the first frame — a file path or a URL. None for text alone.

duration.description: Seconds; the nearest length the model makes.

resolution.description: 480p, 720p, 1080p or 4k; the nearest the model has.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. '16:9'; the nearest the model takes.

size.description: Pixels, e.g. '1280x720'; becomes a ratio and a resolution.

seed.description: For a repeatable video where the model honours it.

audio.description: With sound or without, where the model lets you choose.

negative_prompt.description: What the video should not show, where the model takes it.

yait_aichain.utilities.shell._browse.Loc.name: local_browse
yait_aichain.utilities.shell._browse.Loc.description: List the contents of a local directory as a tree. Use this to explore the filesystem and understand project structure.

input.description: Directory path to list. Relative to sandbox root. Default: root itself.

depth.description: How many directory levels to show (default 2).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to filter files, e.g. '*.py'.

show_hidden.description: Include hidden files and directories (default false).

yait_aichain.utilities.shell._read.Local.name: local_read
yait_aichain.utilities.shell._read.Local.description: Read the contents of a local file. Supports reading a specific line range for large files.

input.description: Path to the file to read (relative to sandbox root).

end_line.description: Last line to return, inclusive (default: all).

yait_aichain.utilities.shell._run.LocalR.name: local_run
yait_aichain.utilities.shell._run.LocalR.description: Execute a shell command or Python file within the sandbox directory. Returns stdout, stderr, and the return code. Use this to run scripts, tests, or any CLI tool.

input.description: Shell command to execute, e.g. 'ls -la' or 'python script.py'. If a .py file path is given, it runs with the current Python.

timeout.description: Max seconds before the process is killed (default 30).

cwd.description: Working directory (relative to sandbox root, default: root).

python.description: Force execution with the current Python interpreter.

yait_aichain.utilities.shell._write.Loca.name: local_write
yait_aichain.utilities.shell._write.Loca.description: Write content to a local file. Creates the file (and any parent directories) if they do not exist. Can overwrite or append.

input.description: Content to write to the file.

path.description: Destination file path (relative to sandbox root).

yait_aichain.utilities.vectors._delete.V.name: vector_delete
yait_aichain.utilities.vectors._delete.V.description: Remove documents from the vector store by ID or metadata filter.  Pass IDs for targeted deletion or a filter dict for bulk removal.

input.description: List of document IDs to delete, or null to delete by filter only.

filter.description: Provider-native metadata filter for bulk deletion.

yait_aichain.utilities.vectors._fetch.Ve.name: vector_fetch
yait_aichain.utilities.vectors._fetch.Ve.description: Retrieve specific documents from the vector store by ID.  Returns full text and metadata without similarity ranking.

input.description: List of document IDs to retrieve.

yait_aichain.utilities.vectors._query.Ve.name: vector_query
yait_aichain.utilities.vectors._query.Ve.description: Semantic similarity search — embed the query text and return the most relevant documents from the vector store.  Use this as the retrieval step in any RAG pipeline.

input.description: The query text to search for semantically similar documents.

filter.description: Provider-native metadata filter applied before ranking.

yait_aichain.utilities.vectors._upsert.V.name: vector_upsert
yait_aichain.utilities.vectors._upsert.V.description: Insert or update documents in the vector store.  Text is embedded automatically when an embedder is configured.  Use this as the ingestion step before RAG retrieval.

input.description: List of records to insert or update.

vector.description: Optional pre-computed embedding vector.  When present, auto-embedding is skipped for this record.
